title: Bag of bones
description:
A Necromancer woke you up in your grave. Now you're a skeleton, and he thinks you're his servant. You're not. Fight your way through the 15 rooms of his crypt and smash him to dust. Your weapons? Your own bones!

The game has a built-in help: choose "How to play" in the main menu. "Learn the sounds" lets you hear every sound in the game.
